title.quote: Metrics and continuity in reinforcement learning

analysis.description: The paper addresses the role of metrics in reinforcement learning, particularly focusing on the induced topology and its impact on reinforcement learning algorithms. It unifies representations of state spaces and continuity through a taxonomy of metrics, analyzing the resulting implications on the Markov Decision Process. The study includes both theoretical formalism and empirical evaluations comparing various metrics, showcasing their effects on generalization in reinforcement learning.

type.justification: The paper primarily develops a theoretical framework of metrics in reinforcement learning, though it includes some empirical evaluations to support the theory.
